scope: All national GTFS route records. Canton membership requires at least one scheduled call inside the complete Ticino polygon on any archived trip, independent of operator or selected dates. Each daily feed retains only trips that themselves call in Ticino, with their entire stop chain. Non-stopping through traffic and services absent from this GTFS are outside the timetable denominator.
